bases.shortName: Woodbine new fire station and fire prevention office
bases.notes: Unmet need outside funded 10-year plan; July 2026 Council requested consideration of acceleration. Separate proposed fire facility from the EMS post on the same property. Civic-address parcel point is not a station footprint.

bases.name: Lower Don Lands / Port Lands new fire station
bases.shortName: Lower Don Lands / Port Lands new fire station
bases.address: Site / civic address not publicly specified
bases.notes: Unmet-needs growth-related station and fire prevention office linked to Port Lands redevelopment. Exact site and opening not located in checked official sources.

bases.name: Multi-Function Paramedic Station 02
bases.notes: September 2025 groundbreaking confirmed in 2026 budget. April 2026 variance revises project completion to December 31, 2029; older construction award contract ended April 30, 2028. Neither is a separately confirmed opening date. Published municipal structure point; entrance not guaranteed.

bases.name: Multi-Function Paramedic Station 03 / 610 Bay hub
bases.notes: June 2026 CreateTO deck confirms redevelopment construction began December 2025. Permanent hub and earlier interim Phase 1 are one site, not two bases. April 2026 variance still separately tracks Phase 1 design through 2028 and Phase 2 through 2031; hub opening date requires confirmation. Municipal point is former terminal entrance, not a verified future ambulance entrance.

bases.name: Multi-Function Paramedic Station 04
bases.notes: Property acquisition and future facility proposed; major works remain an unmet delivery constraint with cash flows planned from 2031. Municipal address layer has multiple land points; no unique future facility point selected.

bases.name: Multi-Function Paramedic Station 05
bases.notes: Design/consolidation delayed by tenant relocation and fuel-site decision. Existing community paramedicine occupancy is not confirmation that the future multi-function station is operational. Phase 2 consolidation remains an unmet need. Civic-address point; future deployment entrance unverified.

bases.name: Ambulance Post 01 – Queen's Plate
bases.notes: Permanent two-bay EMS post; permit and general-contractor tender expected Q4 2026, completion 18–24 months after award. Table still shows 2026 completion but narrative supersedes it. Separate from unfunded future Woodbine fire station. Civic-address parcel point.

bases.name: Bering response-vehicle post / Ambulance Post 02
bases.notes: Report for period ended April 30, 2026 explicitly confirms completed and operational. Exact opening date unknown. Earlier 2020 AODA contract already names Bering Paramedic Post; first opening year is unresolved. No predecessor station/relocation relationship found. Official municipal civic-address land point, not an invented geocoder location.

bases.name: Ambulance Post 03 – Don Mills community recreation centre
bases.shortName: Ambulance Post 03 – Don Mills community recreation centre
bases.notes: Post integrated into Don Mills CRC development. April 2026 dashboard remains delayed; no actual post construction confirmation located. Earlier fall 2026 expectation is not proof of a start. Municipal point identifies the development parcel rather than a final station entrance.

bases.name: Ambulance Post 04 – Finch Avenue East
bases.notes: Approved post with expanded scope; April 2026 dashboard remains delayed. LTC development on same parcel does not prove EMS construction has started. No unique future facility point selected from multiple municipal address points.

bases.name: Future Ambulance Post 05 – site unresolved
bases.address: Site / civic address not publicly specified
bases.notes: Separately enumerated unmet need in Appendix 7. No site, address, procurement or actual construction located; do not place on map.

bases.name: Future Ambulance Post 06 – site unresolved
bases.address: Site / civic address not publicly specified
